title: Checkbox
description: Lets users select one or more options, with indeterminate, error and custom styling support.

props.name: checked
props.description: Checked state (controlled)

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state (uncontrolled)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the checkbox. Inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not set; an explicit `false` overrides the FormControl

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state. Controlled: it stays applied until this prop changes, also after the user clicks

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input, used in forms

props.name: shape
props.description: Box shape

props.name: size
props.description: Checkbox size

props.name: label
props.description: Label content

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the checked / indeterminate box. For a custom look, set the CSS custom properties `--checkbox-checked-color`, `--checkbox-checkmark-color`, `--checkbox-box-color` and `--checkbox-border-color` on `className` or an ancestor

props.name: id
props.description: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when checked

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Extra ids of elements describing the checkbox (aria-describedby)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label, required when there is no visible label

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the checkbox

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon shown when checked

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (inherited from an enclosing FormControl)

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the error state (also set by an invalid enclosing FormControl)

props.name: errorIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the helper text in the error state

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error text shown below the checkbox (linked with aria-describedby)

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Position of the label relative to the box

events.name: onChange
events.typeText: ((checked: boolean, event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement, Element>) => void) | undefined
events.description: Called with the new checked state and the change event

examples.title: Colors and FormControl
examples.description: color sets the semantic checked color (primary, success, info, warning or danger); children can be used as the label. Inside a FormControl the checkbox picks up the id, description, invalid, required and disabled state.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: The newsletter starts subscribed. Toggling it updates the subscription status below.

examples.title: Custom style
examples.description: Recolor the box with the --checkbox-checked-color, --checkbox-checkmark-color, --checkbox-box-color and --checkbox-border-color CSS custom properties (on className or an ancestor), or show a custom icon when checked.

examples.title: Error state
examples.description: error with helperText highlights a checkbox that needs attention.

examples.title: Indeterminate
examples.description: Apple is initially selected. Select all starts mixed, selects every fruit, and clears them on the next activation.

examples.title: Label placement
examples.description: Place the label at the start, end (default), top or bottom of the box.

examples.title: Sizes and shapes
examples.description: Three sizes and three box shapes: square (default), rounded and circle.

examples.title: States
examples.description: Disabled checkboxes, and required for use in native forms.

select-all.title: Select all (indeterminate)
select-all.description: The parent box follows its children through minerva-change: checked when all are, indeterminate (aria-checked="mixed") when only some are.

styles-states.title: Styles and states
styles-states.description: Sizes, shapes, colors, label placement, a custom icon in the icon slot, read-only and error states with helper text.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Form-associated: a checked box submits its value under name, required blocks submission until it is checked, and reset restores the checked attributes.

props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but the user cannot toggle it.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The checked state changed (re-dispatched from the inner input).
events.minerva-change: The user toggled the box; detail: { checked, value }.

slots.default: Label content (alternative to the label attribute).
slots.icon: Custom icon shown inside the box when checked.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.click: Clicks the inner control (toggles it unless disabled or read-only).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
